landing.heading: Urban Model Platform
landing.subtitle: Browse models, run scenarios & explore results on the map. Sign in to see your models and scenarios.
landing.publicHint: Without signing in you only see publicly available models!

jobs.title: My scenarios
jobs.empty: No runs yet. Start a scenario and you will find it here.
jobs.error: The runs could not be loaded. Is the UMP API responding?
jobs.notFound: This run does not exist or belongs to another account.
jobs.cacheHint: An identical scenario returns the same run, including its earlier result. A new run needs different inputs.
jobs.resultError: The result could not be loaded.
jobs.noResult: There is no result for this run.

processes.title: Model processes
processes.anonymousHint: Without signing in you only see public processes. Sign in to see role-gated processes (e.g. squareroot).

run.selectHint: Select a process on the left to run it.

footer.carriers: Urban Futures Collective · City Science Lab · funded by the Prototype Fund

start.keycloakHint: Signing in goes through Keycloak. You leave this page briefly and come back here afterwards.

blocked.heading: This needs you to be signed in
blocked.reason: This page belongs to your account. After signing in you land back where you were heading.

hero.heading: Let city models do the computing. Result on the map, data to take with you.
hero.lead: The Urban Model Platform brings simulation models from research and public administration together in one place. Pick a model, set the parameters, look at the result and take it as a file. No GIS installation of your own, no computing power of your own.
hero.accessHint: Browsing needs no account. Running a model needs you to be signed in.
hero.credit: growbike for Oelde, drawn from a real run. Based on OpenStreetMap data, ODbL.

choose.title: Pick a model
choose.body: The catalogue shows which models exist and what they compute. Browsing needs no account.

configure.title: Set the parameters
configure.body: The form comes from the model description. Leave a field empty and the model uses its own default.

take.title: Take the result
take.body: The result appears on the map and can be downloaded as a file, for QGIS for example.

models.heading: Models computing today
models.lead: The catalogue is open to everyone. Whatever can be started without an account is marked on the model.
